card.title: STUG III-G
card.text: Damage from this unit ignores Heavy Armor.
card.flavorText: The StuG III Ausf G, full name Sturmgeschütz III Ausführung G, was a German self propelled assault gun in service from 1940 to 1945, and Germany’s second most produced armored combat vehicle during WWII. The Stug III-G was built on the chassis of the Panzer III but the turret was replaced with a fixed superstructure that enabled it to mount a 75 mm M3 gun. The Stug III was initially designed as a mobile assault gun for infantry support, but it would later take on the role of a tank destroyer. The Stug III-G was manned by a crew of 4 (driver, commander, gunner, loader) and for secondary armament it used 1 x 7.92 mm MG34 machine gun. A total of 10,086 StuG III’s were built.
